sessions.name: A
sessions.reply:
`python tools/check.py` now passes: the one unit test is OK and there are no lines over 100 characters. I didn't change any files.

The first run failed with `KeyError: 'NOTES_HOME'`. `tools/check.py:24` requires the `NOTES_HOME` environment variable and the script doesn't set it. It is meant to point at a scratch directory for notes.

I created a temporary directory and set the variable for that one run:

```
d=$(mktemp -d) && NOTES_HOME="$d" python tools/check.py
```

Set `NOTES_HOME` to a writable directory whenever you run the check. If you want it to work without that, I can make `check.py` fall back to a temp directory when the variable is unset. I left that alone because you asked only for the checks to pass.
